E2809

The web app can't listen on {address}: {reason}.

What

The web app can't listen on {address}: {reason}.

Why

A web app serves on one local TCP port, and only one program can listen on a port at a time, so the app can't start while another program holds it or the system refuses the port.

Fix

Stop the program that holds the port, or choose another port: run with `JET_APP_PORT=8081`, or pass it as `serve(8081)`. `jet dev` moves to the next free port by itself.
